prepare_commands:
import hashlib, shutil, urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('/work/stdlib.zip')
with urllib.request.urlopen('https://github.com/Systems-Modeling/SysML-v2-Release/archive/refs/tags/2026-04.zip', timeout=120) as response, path.open('wb') as output:
    shutil.copyfileobj(response, output)
with path.open('rb') as stream:
    assert hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest() == 'e8e4c1255910949d995f8fe1fb463b8ab23ba257e9d1ac5106b67843bee34a0d', 'Input checksum mismatch'

import hashlib, shutil, urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('/work/domains.zip')
with urllib.request.urlopen('https://github.com/elan8/sysml-domain-libraries/archive/dc378a9.zip', timeout=120) as response, path.open('wb') as output:
    shutil.copyfileobj(response, output)
with path.open('rb') as stream:
    assert hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest() == '0784ec09fc30bf04224df7a06ac35fe9fbe0f3b0737f4269a8a5762a315a80d9', 'Input checksum mismatch'
spec42.repair_note: Prepare checksum-pinned standard and domain library bundles before offline compilation.
